adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the serialized `@embedding` OpenStruct without reading params or persisting anything (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb: update; `@embedding` built in `fetch_embedding`). On the client, `admin-embedding` controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no button/action invoking `saveChanges` (only `addHost`, and per-host save uses `host.save(...)` in the component). This is misleading/incomplete API/UI wiring, but not a currently broken user path in the diff since nothing triggers the no-op save.
